source.title: Some new results and open problems on periodicity of difference equations

trace.notes: Normalized URL input https://zbmath.org/5233870 as a zbMATH resolver record. Direct fetch returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge, classified as blocked_or_challenged.

Queried https://api.zbmath.org/v1/document/5233870; metadata identified Zbl 1132.39003, title "Some new results and open problems on periodicity of difference equations", authors Francisco Balibrea and Antonio Linero, Grazer Mathematische Berichte 350, pages 15-38 (2006), but links[] was empty and no DOI or full-text URL was provided.

Ran bounded exact-work recovery using the exact title plus PDF, the exact title alone, and Balibrea Linero periodicity search queries. Inspected candidates from zbMATH serial/profile pages, the Uni Graz Grazer Mathematische Berichte catalogue, AIMS/Springer/reference pages, and repository PDFs surfaced in results; accepted none because they were metadata/catalogue records, references in other works, or different papers, not readable full text of the target work.

Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source. Failure mode: metadata_only after the primary zbMATH page was blocked and resolver/API/search recovery found no exact-work readable artifact. The source title was retained from zbMATH resolver metadata; no open-problem extraction was performed from metadata, abstracts, snippets, or related works.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath_5233870.json and outputs/latest.json.
